propose.instructions:
Propose one memory: `flow memory propose --type <decision|fact|preference|term|lesson|event> --title "..." --statement "..." --why "..." --source "owner, <date>"`.
Then run `flow next`.

show-card.instructions:
Show the owner the proposal card, including its id, in your reply.
Ask the owner to approve, reject, or say what to change. Run `flow next` and end your reply.

decide.instructions:
Act on the owner's answer: `flow memory approve <id>`, `flow memory reject <id>`, or `flow memory edit <id> --statement "..."`.
Then run `flow next --decision approved`, `--decision rejected`, or `--decision edited`.

dispatch.instructions:
Start the memory-librarian agent in the background with the Agent tool. Prompt: "Process the queued librarian jobs."
Tell the owner in one line what is being saved. Then run `flow next`.
